simple.meaning: חָמַק (châmaq) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, to wrap ; hence, to depart (i.e. turn about).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חָמַק (H2559) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 5:6, with occurrences in Song of Solomon, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָמַק (H2559) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חָמַק (H2559) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חָמַק (châmaq) / H2559 is traced through Song of Songs 5:6, Jeremiah 31:22 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
